questions.prompt: Which command creates a branch without switching to it?
questions.explanation: `git branch <name>` only creates the branch; `git switch -c` (or the older `git checkout -b`) creates and switches.

questions.prompt: Git refuses `git branch -d feature/login` because the branch is not fully merged. What does the note say?
options: Only `git branch -D` can ever delete it
Merge it or keep it; `-D` force-deletes if you are sure
questions.explanation: If Git says the branch is not fully merged, merge it or keep it; `git branch -D` force-deletes a branch when you are sure it is safe.

questions.prompt: You deleted a branch by mistake. How does the note recover it?
options: `git reflog` to find the last commit, then recreate the branch at that hash
questions.explanation: There is no undo for a branch delete: find the commit with `git reflog` and recreate the branch with `git switch -c <name> <hash>` or `git branch <name> <hash>`.

source.section: ### Recovering a deleted or mistaken branch
